invariants.name: measured LTX baseline is accepted
invariants.description: Known measured LTX values parse when hashes are valid and every uncertified host measurement is explicitly null.
invariants.test_case_name: accepts the measured LTX 2.5 baseline with uncertified host memory fields set to null

invariants.name: GPU concurrency must be positive
invariants.description: A profile with maxConcurrentGpuJobs less than or equal to zero is rejected.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects a render profile when maxConcurrentGpuJobs is not positive

invariants.name: certification hashes are structurally valid
invariants.description: Workflow and every named model hash must be lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 text.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects malformed workflow and model SHA-256 hashes

invariants.name: unknown host measurements are explicit
invariants.description: Uncertified host RAM, process RSS, swap, and page-fault measurements must be present as null rather than omitted.
invariants.test_case_name: requires explicit nulls for host measurements that are not yet certified

invariants.name: review vocabulary is canonical
invariants.description: Only the PRD Scene states and review actions are accepted by transport schemas.
invariants.test_case_name: accepts every canonical scene status and review action

invariants.name: review event states are canonical
invariants.description: Review events reject prior or resulting state values outside the canonical Scene status tuple.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects review events whose prior or resulting status is not canonical

invariants.name: successful unit of work commits both write kinds
invariants.description: When the callback resolves, one staged Scene save and one staged review event become committed together.
invariants.test_case_name: commits one staged scene save and review event when the unit of work succeeds

invariants.name: failed unit of work discards both write kinds
invariants.description: When the callback throws after staging writes, neither the Scene save nor review event is published.
invariants.test_case_name: publishes no staged scene saves or review events when the unit of work callback throws

invariants.name: missing Scene lookup is read-only
invariants.description: A repository miss returns undefined and does not stage or commit a save.
invariants.test_case_name: returns undefined without recording a save when a scene is absent

tasks.title: Implement transactional Scene review use cases

signature_changes.note: New additive application error for use-case lookups.
New additive review orchestration service with primitive-input methods.

invariants.name: director approval is atomic and audited
invariants.description: From director_review, approve transitions to approved, appends one matching approve event, and commits one Scene save in the same UoW.
invariants.test_case_name: approve: director_review transitions to approved, appends approve event, and saves atomically

invariants.name: reroll returns to candidate generation
invariants.description: From director_review, reroll transitions to generating_candidates and commits one matching audit event and Scene save.
invariants.test_case_name: reroll: director_review transitions to generating_candidates and records reroll

invariants.name: approved creative edits invalidate approval
invariants.description: Each creative edit advances revision, clears approval, returns an approved Scene to director_review, and records only its changed field.
invariants.test_case_name: configuration edit: approved invalidates approval, advances revision, and records only the changed field

invariants.name: QA decisions follow the domain state machine
invariants.description: From qa, acceptance reaches completed and rejection reaches director_review, with one correctly mapped event and save for each.
invariants.test_case_name: qa decisions: qa accept completes and qa reject returns to director_review with audit events

invariants.name: review cancellation is audited
invariants.description: A cancellable Scene reaches cancelled and commits one cancel event and one save.
invariants.test_case_name: cancel: a cancellable scene becomes cancelled and records a cancel event

invariants.name: invalid review transitions are write-free
invariants.description: A domain transition error propagates and the transaction commits neither event nor Scene save.
invariants.test_case_name: invalid review transition commits neither a scene save nor a review event

invariants.name: missing review Scene is write-free
invariants.description: A missing Scene throws SceneNotFoundError before an event or save is staged.
invariants.test_case_name: missing review scene throws SceneNotFoundError and commits no writes

invariants.name: review append failure rolls back persistence
invariants.description: If appending the event fails, the UoW publishes neither the event nor the subsequent Scene save.
invariants.test_case_name: review event append failure commits neither the event nor the scene save

tasks.title: Implement transactional Scene production progression use cases

signature_changes.note: New additive production lifecycle orchestration service with primitive-input methods.

invariants.name: candidate generation begins without a review event
invariants.description: From draft_pending or director_review, beginCandidateGeneration transitions to generating_candidates, commits one save, and emits no review event.
invariants.test_case_name: candidate generation start: draft_pending and director_review transition to generating_candidates and save without a review event

invariants.name: candidate generation submits for review without a review event
invariants.description: From generating_candidates, submitCandidatesForReview transitions to director_review, commits one save, and emits no review event.
invariants.test_case_name: candidate submission: generating_candidates transitions to director_review and saves without a review event

invariants.name: approved Scene queues without a review event
invariants.description: From approved, queue reaches queued, commits one save, and emits no director review event.
invariants.test_case_name: queue: approved transitions to queued and saves without a review event

invariants.name: queued Scene begins rendering without a review event
invariants.description: From queued, render start reaches rendering, commits one save, and emits no review event.
invariants.test_case_name: render start: queued transitions to rendering and saves without a review event

invariants.name: rendering Scene submits to QA without a review event
invariants.description: From rendering, submission reaches qa, commits one save, and emits no review event.
invariants.test_case_name: QA submission: rendering transitions to qa and saves without a review event

invariants.name: allowed operational failures persist once
invariants.description: Every state accepted by Scene.fail transitions to failed and commits exactly one save.
invariants.test_case_name: failure: each domain-allowed production state transitions to failed and saves once

invariants.name: failed Scene recovers to director review without a review event
invariants.description: From failed, recoverToReview transitions to director_review, commits one save, and emits no review event.
invariants.test_case_name: failure recovery: failed transitions to director_review and saves without a review event

invariants.name: invalid production transitions are write-free
invariants.description: A domain transition error propagates and no Scene save is committed.
invariants.test_case_name: invalid production transition preserves the domain error and commits no save

invariants.name: missing production Scene is write-free
invariants.description: A missing Scene throws SceneNotFoundError before any persistence call.
invariants.test_case_name: missing production scene throws SceneNotFoundError and commits no writes
